title: Carbon Taxes and Green Subsidies in a World Economy
abstract: We examine positive and normative questions that arise with the joint use of carbon taxes and green subsidies in an open economy. Moving from autarky to free trade induces countries to introduce green subsidies and reduce carbon taxes, in order to reduce foreign emissions. In contrast to the “leakage” effect of carbon taxes, green subsidies are associated with “reverse leakage,” as they decrease emissions both at home and abroad, and as a consequence, the availability of green subsidies tends to be good for global welfare. International climate agreements (ICAs) seek to increase carbon taxes, but the effect on green subsidies is more nuanced. An ICA removes green subsidies, even though they exert positive international externalities at the noncooperative equilibrium. If, however, policies can only be changed gradually, an ICA may start by increasing subsidies before decreasing them over time. We also consider the welfare implications of lobbying from the fossil and green energy sectors. In a noncooperative setting, we find that pressures from the fossil lobby tend to reduce welfare, whereas pressures from the green lobby tend to increase welfare. We also find that in the presence of lobbying, an ICA can decrease welfare relative to the noncooperative equilibrium, even if it changes carbon taxes and green subsidies toward their efficient levels. abstract_zh: 我们考察了在开放经济中同时使用碳税和绿色补贴所引发的实证与规范性问题。从自给自足转向自由贸易，会促使各国引入绿色补贴并降低碳税，以减少境外排放。与碳税的“泄漏”效应相反，绿色补贴则与“逆向泄漏”相关联，因为它们同时减少国内和国外的排放，因此，绿色补贴的存在往往有利于全球福利。国际气候协定（ICA）旨在提高碳税，但其对绿色补贴的影响则更为微妙。国际气候协定会取消绿色补贴，尽管在非合作均衡下，绿色补贴会产生正的国际外部性。然而，如果政策只能逐步调整，国际气候协定可能先提高补贴，之后再随时间逐步降低补贴。我们还考察了化石能源部门与绿色能源部门游说活动的福利影响。在非合作环境中，我们发现来自化石能源游说集团的压力往往会降低福利，而来自绿色游说集团的压力则往往会提高福利。我们还发现，在存在游说的情况下，即使国际气候协定将碳税和绿色补贴调整至有效水平，相对于非合作均衡，它仍可能降低福利。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org上免费下载本文。

Work environment and individual background: explaining regional shirking differentials in a large Italian firm
abstract: The prevalence of shirking within a large Italian bank appears to be characterized by significant regional differentials. In particular, absenteeism and misconduct episodes are substantially more prevalent in the south. We consider a number of potential explanations for this fact: different individual backgrounds; group-interaction effects; sorting of workers across regions; differences in local attributes; different hiring policies and discrimination against southern workers. Our analysis suggests that individual backgrounds, group-interaction effects and sorting effects contribute to explain the northsouth shirking differential. None of the other explanations appears to be of first-order importance.
abstract_zh: 在意大利一家大型银行内部，偷懒（shirking）现象的普遍程度呈现出显著的地区差异。具体而言，旷工和违纪事件在南方地区明显更为普遍。我们考虑了对这一事实的若干潜在解释：个体背景差异；群体互动效应；工人在地区间的分拣（sorting）；当地特征的差异；不同的招聘政策，以及对南方工人的歧视。我们的分析表明，个体背景、群体互动效应和分拣效应有助于解释南北之间的偷懒差异。其他解释似乎都不具有首要的重要性。
